meta.name: Hermes Hub tokens
meta.densityContract: [data-density='compact'] on dense desktop regions (triage list); [data-density='glance'] for phone use

cssNaming.breakpoint.<n>: not a CSS variable; media queries and Tailwind --breakpoint-<n> use the literal value

slate-950.$description: Deepest ops-room slate: trays and code planes

slate-800.$description: Raised slate: cards on the dark board

steel-500.$description: Worn steel: boundaries on the dark board

jersey-yellow-300.$description: Deck-jersey yellow: the decisive action on the dark board

2.$description: Tight gap inside a strip row

3.$description: Default gap inside controls and chips

sm.$description: Kbd keys, chips, strip corners: machined, barely rounded

thick.$description: Selected and pressed boundaries, holder frame

sans.$description: Schibsted Grotesk (variable 400–900), self-hosted in app/fonts.ts: reading text, Questions, labels, controls

mono.$description: Spline Sans Mono (variable 300–700), self-hosted in app/fonts.ts: callsigns, ids, timers, counts, code. Always tabular numerals

condensed.$description: Big Shoulders (variable 100–900), self-hosted from app/fonts/ through next/font/local: strip headers and display only

heavy.$description: Display and holder status words (Schibsted Grotesk and Big Shoulders both ship 800; mono stops at 700)

caps.$description: Uppercase status words, strip headers, kbd legends

fast.$description: Small state changes: press, toggle, hover

panel.$description: Dialogs, sheets, strip expand and collapse

signature.$description: A world signature moment (a Round leaving the board); rare events only, never looping

pulse.$description: Skeleton and reconnecting lamp pulse; runs a bounded number of times

stagger.$description: Delay between siblings entering together; capped at six steps

standard.$description: State changes that start and end on screen

enter.$description: Arriving: quick start, settle, no overshoot

linear.$description: Constant rate: spinners and the Unanswered Policy timer

drawer.$description: Edge-anchored panels: sheets and the strip bay drawer on phone

disabled.$description: Disabled controls; always paired with a text reason when blocking

background.$description: Ops-room base behind every plane. Pairs with foreground.

foreground.$description: Default text on background. 4.5:1 on background and input.

surface-card.$description: Contained objects: roster cards, settings groups, attachments chrome. Pairs with surface-card-foreground.

surface-panel.$description: Side and detail regions: open Round panel, Agent detail. Pairs with surface-panel-foreground.

surface-shelf.$description: Grouping bands inside a panel: Question blocks, filter rows. Pairs with surface-shelf-foreground.

surface-tray.$description: Pinned action regions: the Answer bar, the phone action tray, the app bar. Pairs with surface-tray-foreground.

primary.$description: The one decisive action on a screen: Send Answer, Approve. Pairs with primary-foreground.

secondary.$description: Quiet actions and neutral controls. Pairs with secondary-foreground.

muted.$description: Recessed fills: skeletons, track backgrounds, disabled planes. Pairs with muted-foreground.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text: metadata, hints, timestamps. 4.5:1 on background, every surface, and muted.

accent.$description: Selection and current-item marks (selected strip, current tab). Pairs with accent-foreground.

destructive.$description: Reject, cancel a Round, revoke a token. Always with a text label. Pairs with destructive-foreground.

border.$description: Control and container boundaries. 3:1 against every surface, strip, and input.

input.$description: Field fill for text inputs, selects, and free-text Answers.

ring.$description: Focus ring. 3:1 against every surface, strip, and input.

success.$description: Delivered, saved, connected confirmations. Always with a status word. Pairs with success-foreground.

warning.$description: Needs attention soon: token expiring, policy about to fire. Pairs with warning-foreground.

info.$description: Neutral notices and hints. Pairs with info-foreground.

strip.$description: Round strip paper: the opaque reading plane for a Round. Pairs with strip-foreground; muted-foreground is never used on it.

pending.$description: Holder colour for a Round waiting for the Human. Always beside the word Pending. 3:1 as a boundary against strip and background.

pending-foreground.$description: Status word on the pending holder tab. 4.5:1.

answered.$description: Holder colour for a Round answered and delivered. Always beside the word Answered. 3:1 against strip and background.

answered-foreground.$description: Status word on the answered holder tab. 4.5:1.

expired.$description: Holder colour for a Round whose Unanswered Policy fired or that was cancelled. Always beside Expired or Cancelled. 3:1 against strip and background.

expired-foreground.$description: Status word on the expired holder tab. 4.5:1.

recommended.$description: Marks the Agent's recommended option. A marker, not a status; always with the word Recommended. 3:1 against strip and background.

live.$description: Connected and streaming (SSE live). The only role that may glow (elevation-live). Pairs with live-foreground.

code.$description: Opaque plane for attachments, diffs, and logs. Pairs with code-foreground.

code-foreground.$description: Code text. 4.5:1 on code, diff-add, and diff-remove.

diff-add.$description: Added-line background inside a diff attachment; the line also carries a + sign.

diff-remove.$description: Removed-line background inside a diff attachment; the line also carries a - sign.

agent-1.$description: Agent identity colour 1 (callsign chip edge). Always with the callsign text. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

agent-2.$description: Agent identity colour 2. Always with the callsign text. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

agent-3.$description: Agent identity colour 3. Always with the callsign text. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

agent-4.$description: Agent identity colour 4. Always with the callsign text. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

agent-5.$description: Agent identity colour 5. Always with the callsign text. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

agent-6.$description: Agent identity colour 6. Always with the callsign text. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop behind a modal dialog or sheet; text never sits on it.

chart-1.$description: Chart series 1. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background; series are also labelled.

chart-2.$description: Chart series 2. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

chart-3.$description: Chart series 3. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

chart-4.$description: Chart series 4. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

chart-5.$description: Chart series 5. 3:1 against surface-card, surface-panel, background.

display.$description: Page titles and the board name. Big Shoulders, uppercase allowed

body-lg.$description: Question prompts on an expanded strip

mono.$description: Code, ids, session ids, counts, timers (tabular numerals)

mono-sm.$description: Callsign chips, kbd legends, timer readouts

strip-header.$description: Round strip header: callsign line and Round title, set condensed like a flight-strip block

control-padding-block.$description: Vertical padding inside buttons and inputs

control-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding inside buttons and inputs

row-height.$description: Minimum list, table, and log row height

raised.$description: Cards, strips in the bay, trays. Decorative only.

overlay.$description: Dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus. Decorative only.

live.$description: Live glow. Only on live state (connection lamp, a value streaming now); never decoration.

measure.$description: Maximum line length for Question prompts and prose

bay-width.$description: Strip bay column beside the open Round on desktop

phone-frame-width.$description: Width of a phone (390px) frame in glance blueprints and the density comparison

gallery-column-min.$description: Narrowest /worlds gallery column before the grid adds another

specimen-frame-height.$description: Height of a live world specimen frame in the /worlds gallery

thumbnail-width.$description: Virtual viewport width a /tile thumbnail renders at before /overview scales it

thumbnail-height.$description: Virtual viewport height of a /tile thumbnail (16:10)

raised.$description: Sticky Answer bar and phone action tray above scrolling content

dropdown.$description: Menus and listboxes anchored to a control

overlay.$description: Scrim and modal surfaces when not in the browser top layer

md.$description: Two-column layouts start; below it the phone (glance) layout applies

lg.$description: Command Center: strip bay beside the open Round

button-min-target.$description: Minimum target for buttons and controls (36px desktop). Compact 2rem, glance 3rem.

control-size-sm.$description: Small control (icon buttons in strip rows); scales the target and stays ≥ 24px

strip-min-height.$description: Minimum height of a collapsed Round strip

strip-holder-width.$description: Width of the holder frame rail that wraps a strip in its status colour

timer-track-height.$description: Height of the Unanswered Policy timer track along the strip edge

callsign-chip-height.$description: Height of an Agent callsign chip

option-row-min-height.$description: Minimum height of one choice row in a Question

kbd-size.$description: Minimum width and height of a key hint

icon-size.$description: Inline icon size, relative to text

code-max-height.$description: Maximum height of a code or diff attachment before it scrolls

press-scale.$description: Scale while a control is pressed

enter-scale.$description: Scale overlays start from when entering

contrast.$description: Documented pairs checked by validation/validate-design-system.mjs in every theme, world, and colour option. Every <role>/<role>-foreground pair is checked automatically at 4.5:1. Ratios are truncated, never rounded up.

compact.$description: Dense desktop regions: the triage list, the answered log, Agent roster tables. Lowers padding, gaps, rows, and strip height; the target stays at or above 24px.

control-size-sm.$description: Redeclared so the calc resolves against the compact target (25.6px)

control-size-lg.$description: Redeclared so the calc resolves against the compact target (40px)

glance.$description: Phone use over the tailnet: touch-sized targets, roomier rows, larger body text. Wins over any nested compact region.

option-row-min-height.$description: Glance choice rows: a whole row is a thumb target

control-size-sm.$description: Redeclared so the calc resolves against the glance target (38.4px)

control-size-lg.$description: Redeclared so the calc resolves against the glance target (60px)

hermes-dark.$description: Ops-room slate board with paper-cream strips in dark ink. The default.

hermes-light.$description: Day-shift board: pale bay, white strips, the same holders and callsigns.
